name: Gaza
summary: War and humanitarian catastrophe. The majority of the population has been displaced, much of it repeatedly; famine conditions have been documented by the IPC. Tens of thousands killed.
toll: majority of ~2.2M population displaced · famine conditions documented

name: Sudan
summary: Civil war between the SAF and RSF. The world's largest displacement crisis — over 11 million people driven from their homes — with famine confirmed in parts of Darfur and mass atrocities reported in El Fasher and elsewhere.
toll: 11M+ displaced · famine confirmed (IPC) · mass atrocities reported

name: Eastern DR Congo
summary: M23 offensive atop three decades of conflict in the Kivus. Roughly 7 million people internally displaced — among the largest displacement crises on earth — alongside an active Ebola outbreak.
toll: ~7M internally displaced · Goma seized 2025 · active Ebola outbreak

name: Myanmar
summary: Civil war since the military coup. Over 3.5 million displaced; the Rohingya remain stateless, with hundreds of thousands confined to camps in Bangladesh a decade after genocidal violence drove them out.

name: Haiti
summary: State collapse. Armed groups control most of Port-au-Prince; over a million people displaced inside the country and half the population facing acute hunger.
toll: 1M+ displaced · ~half the population in acute food insecurity

name: Central Sahel
summary: Insurgencies across Burkina Faso, Mali, and Niger. Millions displaced, thousands of schools closed, aid access shrinking — routinely ranked the world's most neglected crisis.
toll: ~3M displaced across three countries · aid access collapsing

name: Ukraine
summary: Full-scale Russian invasion. Millions of refugees across Europe and millions more displaced internally; sustained strikes on civilian infrastructure.

name: Yemen
summary: A decade of war and blockade. One of the world's worst humanitarian crises for years running — most of the population needs assistance, with recurring cholera epidemics and child malnutrition.
toll: ~18M people in need · recurring cholera epidemics

name: Afghanistan
summary: Humanitarian collapse under Taliban rule. Over 20 million people need assistance; women and girls erased from public life, education, and most work.
toll: 20M+ in need · women banned from secondary school and most work
